description: Remove stray tracked *.log files from git

Verify + remove dead client-side source files. DONE: retried git rm on the 21 confirmed-dead files, no sandbox block this time (prior block was transient/session-specific, not persistent). Deleted, staged, tsc --noEmit clean in main checkout.

Verify + remove dead server-side source files from graphify candidate list. DONE: retried git rm on the 5 confirmed-dead files (cache.middleware.ts, errorHandler.middleware.ts, permissions.service.ts, record.service.ts, tenantService.service.ts), no sandbox block this time. Deleted, staged, tsc --noEmit clean in main checkout (required npm install first, node_modules was missing).

Root-cause login/logout session flicker. DONE: race between module-level `store.dispatch(fetchSession())` in _app.tsx:16 and components (Navigation.tsx, SubscriptionGate.tsx, PermissionGate.tsx, CheckoutGuard.tsx) that read `isAuthenticated` without gating on `isAuthenticating`. CheckoutGuard.tsx:16-19 actively redirects an already-logged-in user to /auth/login during the race window. NOT a session/token strategy issue - cookie/JWT mechanism untouched. See TASK-06 for the fix.

Implement session-flicker fix: move fetchSession() dispatch into useEffect in _app.tsx; gate Navigation.tsx/SubscriptionGate.tsx/PermissionGate.tsx/CheckoutGuard.tsx on isAuthenticating before branching auth UI. UI-lifecycle only, no auth/session/cookie strategy change. DONE: implemented by frontend-dev, mirrored into main checkout by team-lead, tsc --noEmit clean in main checkout, security-auditor reviewed all 5 files -> approved, no regressions, no authorization bypass, cookie/JWT mechanism confirmed untouched. Outstanding: before/after Playwright screenshot not captured (no DB/backend available in sandbox) - flagged as outstanding QA evidence, not blocking given security sign-off.
Architecture structural review (layering, circular imports, @shared consistency) via project-graph

Bring stack up via docker compose, full qa-devops Playwright click-through, inline-fix quick established-pattern bugs found: (1) docker-compose port conflicts + missing shared/ volume mount for @shared/* resolution, (2) client auth calls hitting wrong URL because NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL_LOCAL_API was never set, (3) image URL concatenation missing '/' separator crashing next/image across ~13 files, via new getImageUrl() helper.

Fix container-networking duality: server-side Next.js code (SSR/API routes) called NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL_API (host-only, unreachable from inside the client container), blocking login/register. Added INTERNAL_API_URL (container-network address) to docker-compose.yml client env, threaded through httpClient.ts's server-side baseURL branch; browser calls unaffected. [...AUTH].ts now uses relative paths against the shared httpClient. security-auditor reviewed (auth route touched): APPROVE, no secret/cookie/SSRF issues.

Fix GET /api/public/categories failing for anonymous callers (required req.UserId, called vendor-scoped fetchCategories). Added ownership-agnostic fetchAllCategoriesPublic()/handleFetchPublicCategories(); authenticated fetchCategories() untouched. team-lead review caught two issues in the as-committed version, both fixed: (1) PII leak -- public function's Owner include had 'email' attribute, leaking vendor email to anonymous callers via createdBy.email; removed. (2) all 4 SubCategory includes in category.service.ts (incl. the new public one) requested a nonexistent 'description' column, throwing a Postgres column-not-found error on any category with subcategories -- removed the bad attribute (pre-existing bug, same fix applied consistently, not a scoping change). Live-verified GET /api/public/categories returns 200 with real data, no email field. security-auditor reviewed: APPROVE (design correct, no IDOR/SSRF; PII fix logic confirmed sound, re-verified against the committed file post-commit per its request).

qa-devops focused pass: retest login/register/product-detail/cart/checkout (previously networking-blocked) + first-time coverage of 13 admin-dashboard rows using superadmin credential. Results: Register/Dashboard/Roles/Permissions/Orders/Categories/Articles WORKING. Login PARTIAL (BFF proxy returns unwrapped response, false-failure toast despite valid session -- auth code, not fixed, Always-Stop). Product-detail fixed inline (next.config.js image remotePattern, commit 67809d0). Cart/Checkout/Stores/Shipping/Taxes/Promotions/Returns/Comments/Users all BROKEN -- distinct bugs, logged not fixed (out of this round's scope, none are one-line/established-pattern). CRITICAL finding: GET /api/users (Users admin page's underlying call) returns bcrypt password hashes in the response body -- credential/PII leak, needs urgent security-auditor + backend-node dispatch, flagged to CEO.

Fix CRITICAL password-hash leak (GET /api/users + admin create/update + public register all returned full User row incl. bcrypt hash; no model defaultScope existed). Excluded password at query level in fetchUsersByCreator (attributes.exclude) and stripped it from create/update return values in user.service.ts + users.service.ts. Grep-swept all other db.User.find*/create call sites -- none leak (existing ones already allow-list or never return the row). Also fixed: (a) admin Users-list 'No users found' -- root cause was NOT a data-binding bug as assumed, it was a client-side race where the fetch fired before the app-level session-restore effect registered the Authorization header, producing a silently-swallowed 401; gated the fetch in client/pages/users/index.tsx on isAuthenticated && !isAuthenticating. (b) login BFF proxy (pages/api/user/[...AUTH].ts handleSignIn) returned an unwrapped response with accessToken dropped entirely -- now returns {success,message,data} with accessToken in data, matching userSlice's signIn thunk expectation. Live-verified via Playwright against the docker-compose stack: GET /api/users now 200 with no password field and 8 real records rendered in the main list; login shows no false-failure toast. security-auditor reviewed all three fixes together: APPROVE, no blockers (full table in daily-log). Non-blocking follow-ups filed, not fixed: accumulating httpClient request interceptors on every login/session-fetch (frontend-dev ticket), missing .rejected case in myUsersSlice's fetchUsersByCreator, and a recommended future HIGH-tier auth/session-design review (httpOnly-cookie-only migration) -- Always-Stop, routed to CEO/Founder, not actioned here.

description: Order model real fix: added orderNumber (unique, human-readable, ORD-YYYYMMDD-<8hex>) via a new server/src/migrations/ runner (project had no sequelize-cli; runScripts.ts's sync() only creates missing tables, never ALTERs existing ones, so migrations now run first via `npm run migrate` / wired into `npm run setup`). Total is COMPUTED (order.service.ts#computeOrderTotal from OrderItem.price*quantity), not stored -- avoids a duplicated total silently drifting on order mutation; Order has no checkout-total write path that would need to update it anyway. return.controller.ts + shipping.controller.ts now select real orderNumber + eager-load orderItems to attach a computed total; stopgap attribute-select + comments removed. Found and fixed a real pre-existing bug along the way: Order model's TS class-field declarations (`orderNumber!: string` etc.) under tsconfig target ESNext shadow Sequelize's prototype attribute accessors (useDefineForClassFields) -- the orderNumber-generation hook had to use setDataValue/getDataValue, not plain assignment, to actually persist (same shadowing already explains the pre-existing `order.dataValues.id` workaround in payment.service.ts). Migration applied + re-run idempotency-verified against the disposable docker-compose dev DB (postgres:5434); tsc --noEmit clean in the running server container; live-verified via superadmin token against GET /api/returns and GET /api/shipping/orders on :5300 -- real orderNumber (e.g. ORD-20260922-000001) and computed total (e.g. 1059.97) returned, HTTP 200, no 500s.
